name: doctor-advanced-workflow
description: Advanced diagnostics workflow with auto-fix and predictive analysis
author: Kubit Team

steps.name: Enable doctor advanced plugin
steps.content:
[plugins]
enabled = ["@kubit/plugin-doctor-advanced"]

[doctor]
autofix.enabled = {{ enableAutoFix }}
predictive.enabled = true
predictive.riskThreshold = 60

steps.name: Create GitHub Actions doctor workflow
steps.content:
name: Doctor Advanced

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # Weekly on Sunday

jobs:
  doctor:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
        with:
          version: 10
      
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install
      
      - name: Doctor Basic
        run: pnpm kubit-forge doctor
      
      - name: Doctor Auto-Fix (Dry Run)
        run: pnpm kubit-forge doctor:fix --dry-run
      
      - name: Predictive Diagnostics
        run: pnpm kubit-forge doctor:predictive
      
      - name: Export Diagnostics
        run: pnpm kubit-forge doctor:export --format {{ exportFormat }} --output diagnostics.{{ exportFormat }}
      
      - name: Upload Diagnostics
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: diagnostics
          path: diagnostics.*
      
      - name: Upload to GitHub Code Scanning (SARIF only)
        if: ${{ '{{ exportFormat }}' == 'sarif' }}
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        with:
          sarif_file: diagnostics.sarif

steps.name: Add doctor scripts to package.json
steps.script: npm pkg set scripts.doctor:fix='kubit-forge doctor:fix' scripts.doctor:predictive='kubit-forge doctor:predictive' scripts.doctor:export='kubit-forge doctor:export --format sarif'

steps.name: Create VS Code task for doctor
